_comment: Knowledge-as-data. Every hard-won lesson that used to live as a prose comment beside a regex now lives here as a row with a test pinning it. SFW rows are filled; rows marked "_payload": "explicit" are intentionally left blank for the operator to fill on their side (the builder is code, the explicit payload is data, and the data is the part that stays off this repo's Claude side).

base.positive_suffix: Shot on DSLR, natural skin texture.
base.solo_anchor: solo, a single woman alone in the frame, only one person,

profiles._note: Chroma/Flux duplicate the subject ('two of her') in tall >1MP latents. Always-on solo-merge suppression. Keep every gen near 1MP (see dims).
Trims the extremity tangles (extra foot/hand/limb) that turn up in extreme foreshortened poses. Model-agnostic, cheap insurance.
A garment must stay on: lead the render toward the outfit and hold it with higher cfg. Clothed wins the cfg contest over pose (matches old extra_neg branch).
profiles.positive_extra: the named garments clearly worn and visible on her body.

profiles._note: Lying / spread / kneeling / on-top needs a full-body frame, higher cfg, and extra steps to clean up extremities. cfg here yields to 'clothed' when both fire; steps is owned here.
profiles._note_negative: Overhead/top-down on a reclining body foreshortens into a shape the model completes with a second head/body. Pure camera-angle vocab, fully SFW.

profiles._note: She composes on a MacBook, never by hand. Anchor the laptop and negate the pen-and-paper attractor. Fully SFW — filled.
profiles.positive_extra: hands on the keyboard typing on her open silver MacBook laptop, fingers resting on the keys, no pen or paper.

profiles._note: From-behind framing. QA must reject front-facing renders (require_rear_qa). Fill anchor/positive_extra/negative (front-view push) on your side.
On-back legs-raised framing that avoids the second-inverted-face artifact. Fill positive_extra/negative on your side.
POV act with the viewer. INVERTS the solo guard (a partial second body is wanted): drop_solo=true, partner_qa=true, pose cfg/steps. Fill anchor/positive_extra/negative on your side.
Upright facing partner poses foreshorten feet up by the head. Pose-gated: applies only when partner AND NOT rear AND NOT legs_up. Fill negative on your side.
